english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for optimistically wanting or expecting something to happen or to obtain something.

exampleSentences.english: I hope it won't rain tomorrow.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ting1 jat6 m4 hou2 lok6 jyu5

english.note: Use this for strongly hoping that an outcome will happen, rather than addressing a deity or pleading with a person.

exampleSentences.english: I pray it won't rain tomorrow.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ting1 jat6 m4 hou2 lok6 jyu5

english.note: Use this when expressing hope for a particular outcome, especially one that may be unlikely.

exampleSentences.english: I wish it wouldn’t rain tomorrow.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ting1 jat6 m4 hou2 lok6 jyu5
